title: 第7章 女勇者拉拢第8章 半夜开无双
slug: 我妈等着治病你召唤我当勇者
content_zh:
她身后七八只双眼赤红的风狼紧追不舍。
獠牙毕露，口中发出嗜血的低吼。
显然，这个女人正在被追杀。
林默眉头微皱。
他自诩不是什么嗜杀的恶人。
但也绝非圣母心泛滥的白痴。
这女人的生死，与他何干？
他不想节外生枝，浪费时间。
然而就在他准备离开的时候，目光不经意扫过那女人手中的武器。
林默的动作不由得一顿。
那是一把短匕，造型简洁。
但关键在于，那匕首的刃身上，正散发着一种柔和却坚定的微光！
这种光芒……不就是之前在教堂见过的光明圣装么？
她也是勇者？
林默立刻想起了之前教堂有人议论过。
古木城的城主在半个月前进行过一场召唤仪式。
召唤了多名勇者。
看来，眼前这个女人就是其中之一？
就是这短暂的观察与犹豫，让那亡命奔逃的女人也发现了他。
在看到他，以及他脚下那片狼藉的风狼尸体时。

女人眼中瞬间爆发出强烈的求生光芒。
仿佛抓住了最后一根救命稻草。
她一边奋力奔跑，一边用尽力气朝着林默大声喊道：“救命啊！救救我！”
女人颤抖的声音在空旷的山丘脚下显得格外清晰。
听着女人因恐惧而颤抖的声音，林默眉头微皱。
就在他这片刻的迟疑间，那个女人已经冲到了他面前。
速度快得几乎要摔倒。
她完全是出于本能，一个闪身就缩到了林默背后。
双手死死抓住林默腰侧的衣服。
她惊魂未定地从他肩膀后方探出半个脑袋。
这时林默才有时间打量这个女人。
看样子二十七八岁。
脸色因为奔跑而有些发白。
林默心中暗想，不知道杀了勇者会不会有额外奖励。
而那个女人躲在林默的身后，一双眼睛飞快地扫视着周围，又迅速瞥向左右两侧。
content_en:
Behind her, seven or eight wind wolves with red eyes were chasing after her.
His fangs were exposed and he let out a bloodthirsty growl.
Clearly, this woman is being hunted.
Lin Mo frowned slightly.
He prides himself on not being a murderous villain.
But he is definitely not an idiot with a Holy Mother's heart.
What does this woman's life and death have to do with him?
He didn't want to add unnecessary complications and waste time.
However, just as he was about to leave, his eyes inadvertently glanced at the weapon in the woman's hand.
Lin Mo couldn't help but hesitate.
It was a short dagger with a simple shape.
But the key is that the blade of the dagger is emitting a soft but firm glimmer!
This kind of light...isn't it the bright holy dress I saw in the church before?
Is she also a hero?
Lin Mo immediately remembered that someone in the church had discussed it before.
The city lord of Gumu City performed a summoning ceremony half a month ago.
Summoned many brave men.
It seems that the woman in front of me is one of them?
It was this brief observation and hesitation that made the fleeing woman discover him.
When I saw him and the messy wind wolf corpse at his feet.
The woman's eyes instantly burst out with a strong light of survival.
It was as if I had grasped the last straw.
While running hard, she yelled at Lin Mo with all her strength: "Help! Help me!"
The woman's trembling voice was particularly clear at the foot of the empty hill.
Listening to the woman's voice trembling with fear, Lin Mo frowned slightly.
During his moment of hesitation, the woman had already rushed in front of him.
He was so fast that he almost fell down.
She was completely instinctive and shrank behind Lin Mo in a flash.
Both hands firmly grasped the clothes at Lin Mo's waist.
She poked half her head out from behind his shoulder in shock.
Only then did Lin Mo have time to look at this woman.
He looks to be in his mid-twenties.
His face was a little pale from running.
Lin Mo thought to himself, wondering if there would be any extra reward for killing the brave man.
The woman was hiding behind Lin Mo, her eyes quickly scanning the surroundings, and then quickly glanced to the left and right.
